ground_truth_draft.expected_behavior: For HTTP/2 CONNECT requests carrying a Protocol extension (RFC 8441 Extended CONNECT), the client must preserve :scheme and :path on the wire instead of rewriting the URI to authority-form. Plain HTTP/2 CONNECT (no Protocol extension) and the http2-disabled build path continue to use authority-form.
ground_truth_draft.rationale_from_pr_metadata: PR title: 'fix(client): Do not strip `path` and `scheme` components from URIs for HTTP/2 Extended CONNECT requests'. Body cites RFC 8441 §4 requiring `:scheme` and `:path` when `:protocol` is present, and shows HAProxy 2.8 rejecting the prior request as invalid; after the patch the WebSocket-over-H2 handshake succeeds. Reviewer nox: 'Would be nice to have a test'; subsequent commits add h2_connect_authority_form and h2_extended_connect_full_uri integration tests, confirming the protocol-contract scope.
